name: Himicheskij perepoloh
source:
Weeks of private lectures on potions with Ezarel came to an end, and it's time to move on to practice. The head of Absinthe wants to make sure that you have appropriately mastered the acquired knowledge and did not waste his time. 
Can you brew the potion perfectly? Or maybe surprise the elf with an unexpected improvisation? You decide!
This game is a fangame based on Eldarya. It is small and has an exceptionally entertaining purpose, since it is timed to the April Fool's. Please do not look for a deep meaning - it swam away with Blobby and does not want to return.
translation:
与伊扎雷尔为期数周的魔药私人讲座结束了，是时候继续练习了。苦艾酒的负责人希望确保你已经适当地掌握了所学到的知识，并且没有浪费他的时间。
你能完美地酿造药剂吗？或者用意想不到的即兴创作给精灵一个惊喜？你决定！
该游戏是一款基于Eldarya的同人游戏。它很小，但有一个非常有趣的目的，因为它的时间是愚人节。请不要寻找深层含义——它和布洛比一起游走了，不想再回来了。
